aggregate_refit.permitted_role: 2024 outcomes are historical before every 2025 target date

claim_limit: This is a pre-existing-outcome retrospective audit, not a never-seen confirmation. Report assembly was transparently recovered from immutable monthly prediction artifacts after bounded float32 normalization. It supports comparative predictive claims on the BTS top-100 cohort only; it does not establish causal, operational, real-time, fairness, or safety effects.

confirmation_gate.rule: No 2026 outcome may be acquired, loaded, tuned, or scored.

diagnostics.interpretation: post-freeze descriptive heterogeneity; not additional model selection
